mathematical_result.logical_scope: Exclusion of every smaller order and a witness at six proves the minimum over all finite connected simple undirected unweighted graphs under the frozen convention. No enumeration above six is needed for that minimum; the result does not classify graphs of order seven or more and does not extend to weighted, directed or nonsimple classes.
